courseOutcomes.description: Understand the concept, properties and important models of discrete random variables and to apply in suitable random phenomena.
Understand the concept, properties and important models of continuous random variables and to apply in suitable random phenomena.
Estimate population parameters, assess their certainty with confidence intervals, and test hypotheses about population means and proportions using z-tests and the one-sample t-test.

Analyze random processes by classifying them, describing their properties, utilizing autocorrelation functions, and understanding their applications  in areas like signal processing and communication systems.
